reviews.text:
End of an era. When I got this app it was LightX and it was absolutely fantastic for editing photos on the fly. I was impressed with what you could do for free compared to other photo editing apps on the market. After a few weeks, I went ahead and paid for the full version as the developers clearly put a massive effort in this app.

Today, I am reviewing my pending app updates and see a new app that I know I didn’t download with “AI” in the name. Slightly confused, I checked the app history and see that it is LightX and thought maybe they are adding AI capabilities to my already paid app (for an additional cost of some kind, of course) but upon reading the app description, I see that it actually turns the app I already paid for into an annually billed subscription service. 

I am so glad I take the time to read these app updates prior to blindly clicking the update button. I know the developers are going to send a canned apology but, please, there is no need for the theatrics. You have some great developers and I am sure your AI app is great but I am not interested in paying any subscription fee for something I occasionally tweak my mobile phone photos on. 

Looks like this is where we part ways. Thank you for the years of use, LightX. Tapping delete is a far less cruel way to erase you from existence than updating you to another annual subscription AI artistry app.

You will be missed but never forgotten.
